other_conditions: The enterprise must be a Micro or Small Enterprise registered in Rajasthan.
Must possess a Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per the MSME Development Act 2006.
The technology or software acquired must be directly related to the enterprise’s production/manufacturing process.

The applicant must demonstrate a performance improvement (at least 10% increase in production rate, or 5% decrease in cycle time, or 2.5% decrease in rejection rate, or 10% decrease in waste generation) certified by a Chartered Engineer.
The enterprise must be in commercial production at the time of disbursement; assistance will not be released to closed units.
Only one machine/equipment per enterprise is eligible; multiple similar machines are not entertained.
benefits_summary: One‑time reimbursement up to 50 % of the technology acquisition cost, capped at ₹5,00,000 per unit.
